name: Kuang Grade Mark Eleven Playbooks & Knowledge
description: Standard operating procedures, orthogonal primitive workflows, Set-of-Marks strategies, HIL protocols, LLM-friendly discovery (llms.txt / Markdown negotiation), web search, deep crawl, and anti-bot handling for Kuang browser automation.

partitions.name: CAPTCHA & Anti-Bot Strategies
partitions.summary: Step-by-step procedures for text CAPTCHAs, Turnstile challenges, and triggering HIL alerts.

partitions.name: Selector & Set-of-Marks Recipes
partitions.summary: Best practices for using take_screenshot(marks:true) and resilient CSS/XPath selectors.

partitions.name: Browser Navigation Playbook
partitions.summary: Guidelines for multi-tab orchestration, 0ms speculative prerender navigation, and session persistence.

partitions.name: Orthogonal Primitives & Workflow Recipes
partitions.summary: The primitive layer (observe/act/wait_for/expect/find/extract/collect_all/page_state/diff/export_har/contexts) and the discovery layer (llm_surface/llm_fetch/search_web/deep_crawl/research_topic), the shared wait-condition vocabulary, structured error codes, and focus-independent input / background-rendering guarantees.
